messages:
incident-bot: P1 - embed-service high 5xx rate detected in us-west-2. alerting on >5% 5xx for 3m. Pager: @Aisha Khan. Logs indicate KV cache errors around 2026-07-02T09:07Z.
Aisha Khan: got the page, looking. thanks incident-bot. starting triage.
Aisha Khan: initial check: CPU on GPU hosts normal, but embed-workers show many `kv_cache.populate` exceptions. attaching recent log tail.
Aisha Khan: ```
2026-07-02T09:06:12Z ERROR kv_cache: populate failed key=proj:1234 err="quota exceeded"
2026-07-02T09:06:13Z WARN embed: fallback to cold compute
2026-07-02T09:06:14Z ERROR http: send 503 to client id=abc123
```
Ben Li: I'm nearby, will join for mitigation. any obvious recent deploy? @deploy-bot any deploys past 30m?
deploy-bot: No production deploys in last 60 minutes for embed-service.
Carlos Mendez: possibility: cache eviction/stampede under a burst from a customer? Are we seeing traffic spikes?
Aisha Khan: traffic increased ~2.4x from a single client ip block starting 09:05Z. request size heavier than normal (long contexts).
Dana Park: I'm going to scale the embed worker pool by +3 instances in us-west-2 and temporarily raise KV cache capacity. doing: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/embed-workers --replicas=9`
Dana Park: scaled. also toggling `kv_cache.max_inflight` from 200 -> 400 in runtime config. applying now.
Aisha Khan: 📈 after scale and kv tuning, 5xx rate dropping from 8% -> 1.2% in the last 2m. good signal. keep monitoring.
Ben Li: added a rate-limiting rule proto to block the aggressive client until they reduce request rate: `route-filter client_ip:1.2.3.0/24 block 1m`. applied as emergency.
Carlos Mendez: thanks. can we also fallback any long-context requests to a lower-memory model variant to reduce cache churn?
Dana Park: toggled fallback policy to route >2048 token requests to `embed-small-v1` in us-west-2. tests look OK.
Aisha Khan: customer impact: observed degraded embed latency and 503s affecting 0.6% of overall customers, primarily one enterprise tenant (tenant-id: 8765). notified CS.
Elaine Zhou: CS update: tenant 8765 reported errors in their ingestion pipeline. 3 partial failures recorded between 09:06-09:13Z. they are investigating.
Frank O'Connor: putting a note for legal/compliance: any data loss? they saw retries but no dropped objects reported.
Aisha Khan: no data loss confirmed; transient 503s triggered retries. storage and logs intact.
Ben Li: recommend immediate post-incident actions: 1) full postmortem owner 2) runbook update 3) add automated rate limiter for single-client spikes 4) chaos test for KV cache eviction.
Carlos Mendez: volunteering to own the postmortem writeup. target publish by EOW.
Aisha Khan: thanks @Carlos. I'll be incident lead on the timeline + mitigation notes.
Dana Park: I'll create the urgent runbook patch PR for embed-service caching behavior. linking to tests.
Dana Park: PR: https://git.internal/r/inference/ops/PR/542 (draft)
Aisha Khan: handoff time: my oncall ends in 45m. @Ben Li can you take on-call for final monitoring and ensure mitigations remain stable?
Ben Li: taking handoff. will monitor for 2h and escalate if any regression. updating #oncall-rotation.
incident-bot: oncall-handoff: previous_oncall=Aisha Khan next_oncall=Ben Li at 1765003000.
Carlos Mendez: postmortem checklist I'd like in the doc: timeline, root cause hypothesis, impact quant (tenant IDs, %requests, minutes), rollback/mitigation timeline, code/config diff, action items with owners and due dates, follow-up tests.
Aisha Khan: noted. initial root cause hypothesis: aggressive client request pattern plus TTL misconfiguration in KV cache causing massive repopulation and quota exhaustion.
Elaine Zhou: CS wants a brief after-action note to customers by EOD. I'll draft and coordinate with legal.
Frank O'Connor: add task to integrate per-tenant throttling metrics into Console dashboards. owner: Frank. due: 2026-07-09.
Dana Park: action item: expand KV cache observability (histograms for populate latency, inflight counts). owner: Dana. due: 2026-07-05.
Ben Li: action item: implement automatic emergency throttle for single-IP bursts. owner: Ben. due: 2026-07-08.
Carlos Mendez: postmortem doc planned meeting: Thu 2026-07-08 1600 UTC (30m) — invite sent to eng-infra, eng-runtime, product, cs.
Aisha Khan: add a brown-bag session to share learnings and prevention patterns: propose Tue 2026-07-13 1700 UTC. agenda: causes of KV stampedes, runbook updates, rate-limit best practices, demo of chaos test.
Elaine Zhou: CS + Solutions Eng will join brown-bag to review customer-facing mitigation playbook.
Aisha Khan: tagging follow-ups: - Carlos: write postmortem (EOW) - Dana: runbook PR + observability (2026-07-05) - Ben: emergency throttle + dashboard alert (2026-07-08) - Frank: Console metric tile (2026-07-09) - Elaine: customer comms (EOD today)
Ben Li: I'll add automated synthetic tests to exercise long-context fallback in the staging harness. will open PR.
Carlos Mendez: draft postmortem link (WIP): https://docs.internal/postmortems/1765001234-embed-kvcache-dos (will update)
Aisha Khan: good work team. keeping this thread for any follow-ups. please update the postmortem doc with logs and the final timeline.
incident-bot: incident-closed: status=resolved duration=38m mitigation=scale + kv config + per-client emergency throttle closed_by=Aisha Khan closed_at=1765003578
Ben Li: confirming stable for 45m after closure. I'll brief night oncall during handoff.
Aisha Khan: handing off final notes to Ben. thanks all. :tada:
Frank O'Connor: looking forward to the brown-bag. can we record it for wider team?
Aisha Khan: yes will record and upload slides to the learning repo.
Carlos Mendez: postmortem draft done, pinged reviewers.
Ben Li: leaving monitoring to infra alerts. please escalate if anything pops.
Aisha Khan: last note: we should add a post-incident retrospective item for 'simulate per-tenant burst + kv eviction' to our quarterly reliability goals.
Dana Park: added to backlog: REL-2026-78.
Aisha Khan: closing thread for now, will reopen if new developments. thanks again everyone.
